title: feat(server): body-size cap hook
description:
Adds middleware to reject `POST /notes` bodies > 64KB with 413. Client sees `x-loop-note-too-large: true` and renders a friendly toast (splits the note).

Closes LOOP-215. Depends on middleware pipeline in LOOP-142.

## Test plan
- Unit: `src/server/middleware/body-cap.test.ts`
- Integration: `tests/e2e/note-too-large.spec.ts` (drives the toast)
